items.title: UK household structure today
items.claim: What proportion of UK households in 2022 were single-person households according to the Office for National Statistics?
items.reveal_title: Roughly three in ten UK households are one person
items.reveal:
ONS data for 2022 reported around 30% of households contained a single person. The figure has risen steadily since the 1960s.

The 'standard' nuclear family is now a minority household type.
items.why: Demographic change reshapes assumptions built into policy and earlier sociological theory.

items.title: Weber's iron cage
items.claim: Max Weber argued modernity was driven by rationalisation. What did his 'iron cage' (stahlhartes Gehause) refer to?

options.text: The bureaucratic and economic systems constraining individual freedom in modern society

items.reveal_title: Bureaucratic rationality as a constraining structure
items.reveal:
In The Protestant Ethic and the Spirit of Capitalism (1905), Weber argued the rational pursuit of efficiency would outlast the religious motives that birthed it, trapping moderns in a structure they could not easily escape.

Parsons's English translation 'iron cage' is now standard; 'shell as hard as steel' is closer to the German.
items.why: Translation shapes how foundational concepts travel between languages and disciplines.
